The text is text/OFL-1.1.txt of spdx/license-list-data at the commit in source, 31846481 of 2026-10-29 (the file itself last changed in b8d6af45 of 2021-02-28, SHA-256 8eea8287e5876b539670cadb82e99f9a7afddec6f6730811be1daf25d2e9bcfd); it holds no template copyright line, so the fonts' own lines, read from the name tables, head it as the licence asks, with the Reserved Font Names after them. entities@8.1.0.reason: dist/decode-codepoint.js, which markdown-it's decoder imports and the text chunk keeps, begins "Adapted from https://github.com/mathiasbynens/he/blob/36afe179392226cf1b6ccdb16ebbb7a5a844d93a/src/he.js#L106-L134": a table of the 32 C1 replacements and the code point check, which he published under MIT. The entities package's LICENSE is BSD-2-Clause (Felix Boehm) only and names he nowhere. The MIT text is LICENSE-MIT.txt of mathiasbynens/he at the commit the file cites, 36afe179392226cf1b6ccdb16ebbb7a5a844d93a of 2018-09-23 (git blob a41e0a7ef970ecdd83d82cd99bda97b22077bc62, last changed in f48a09683fcee1ad0ea8ec164333cf5103782a46 of 2014-08-24, read with gh api and checked with git hash-object). The entry names no fonts, and the notice reads BSD-2-Clause AND MIT. Whether adapting a table the HTML standard defines needs he's notice is a licence call nobody has made; shipping the text costs nothing (review of checkpoints 2.3 and 4.4, U-1). Used by the text chunk (atoms, task 5.1).
